<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm and fits the observed isotopic pattern is C₁₂H₆O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H6O2</final_answer>
